hypothesis: Seeds 70-72 (N=64, 4 layers, d_model=64, m2 in [0.1, 1], 600 steps) give raw layer-4 accel_step R2 of 0.799-0.813 at e<=0.7 and 0.541-0.570 at e<=0.85. The loss of linear decodability between those two ceilings is gradual, not concentrated in one interval. At e in [0, 0.75], raw accel_step R2 is about where linear interpolation puts it (~0.72), well below the e<=0.7 values and well above the e<=0.85 values.
expected_if_true: Final best-layer accel_step R2 is in [0.66, 0.77] in all 3 seeds. Best-of-5 control R2 falls between the seed-matched e<=0.7 (0.54-0.56) and e<=0.85 (0.26-0.27) values. Accel_step margin is >= 0.1 in all seeds. Formation timing is reported but not part of the criterion.
expected_if_false: Raw accel_step R2 >= 0.78 in at least 2 of 3 seeds, meaning decodability holds to e<=0.75 and the drop is concentrated above 0.75. Or raw R2 <= 0.65 in at least 2 of 3 seeds, meaning most of the drop is between 0.7 and 0.75. Any other mixed outcome is inconclusive.
